$Comment: Bring down the Headless Horseman on Hard Mode during one season with nothing but Lantern Bombs hitting
his body. ENCOUNTER_FEAT names his hard fight's encounter script, Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter_Hard,
and the feat Lanterns_Only, which that fight's binding row defines under Progression.Feats exactly as
his normal fight's row does: every hit any player lands on his body must come from a Lantern Bomb's
blast, shards or burn, while his Head and the Jack Skeletons may be hit with anything. Every player the
win credits earns it at once.
Rewards.Auto pays what lands the moment it is earned: the title Hallows_Eve_Lamplighter (the Title
reward kind). Every year's copy names the same title, so a second year unlocks nothing new.
Rewards.Claim waits on the achievements page until the player collects it: MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp
row, Artillery XP, whose own Requires (the hytale:mod_installed gate) leaves it out on a server
without that mod. It carries no hallowed tag, so The Hallowed never waits on it.
